decisions.briefing: Markets were flat-to-slightly-negative today (NASDAQ -0.3%, S&P 500 -0.1%), with no risk-on signal strong enough to justify deploying the $989 in cash across our 3 open slots. Several screened candidates (PARR, CDNA, VG, NEO, ORCL, CHTR) show strong technical scores, but none carry the volume-surge confirmation our strategy memory flags as needed for high-conviction entries, so we're holding and waiting for a clearer setup.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices drifted slightly lower today in quiet, directionless trading, with NASDAQ down 0.3% and the S&P 500 down 0.1%. There was no single dominant catalyst driving the move, suggesting investors are in a wait-and-see mode rather than reacting to a specific shock. Light, mixed trading like this often precedes a bigger directional move once a clearer catalyst emerges.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市窄幅波動，納指跌0.3%，標普500跌0.1%，走勢欠缺明顯方向。市場未見單一主導因素帶動，反映投資者正處於觀望狀態，而非對個別消息作出強烈反應。此類淡靜且方向不明的交投，往往是較大行情出現前的醞釀期。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A stock can look technically strong on paper (good RSI, bullish MACD crossover, price above its moving average) but still lack full confirmation if trading volume isn't backing up the move. Volume surges often signal that institutional investors are participating, not just short-term traders, which makes a breakout more likely to hold. Waiting for that extra signal before buying can help avoid chasing moves that fizzle out.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 一隻股票的技術指標可能表面亮麗（RSI理想、MACD黃金交叉、股價高於均線），但若成交量未能同步配合，訊號就未算完整確認。成交量放大通常代表機構投資者參與其中，而非僅是短炒資金，令突破走勢更有機會持續。在買入前等待這額外訊號出現，有助避免追入最終後勁不繼的升浪。
